formulas.formula: Dark mode. Clear plan. Debt-free date in sight.
1. Setup: pick a strategy (Snowball or Avalanche), the extra amount you can pay each month, and your start month.
2. Debts: list every debt with balance, APR and minimum payment.
3. Payoff Plan: your month-by-month plan. When one debt is gone, its payment rolls into the next one.
4. Payment Log: log real payments to watch your progress.
5. Dashboard: your debt-free date, interest saved, and the order to attack.
Smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you motivated.
Highest interest rate first. Saves the most money.
Paid off a debt? Keep paying the same total. The freed payment attacks the next debt.
Want your own order? Choose Custom and number the debts on the Debts tab.
Clear the light cells on Debts and Payment Log, then update Setup.
Dark cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid off, or on track.
Amber: next up, or worth a look.
Red: never paid off, or something to check.
One payment at a time. You'll get there.
Snowball, Avalanche or Custom. Blank = Snowball.
="Total paid toward debt each month: "&TEXT(R9,"$#,##0")&" (all minimums + extra). Strategy: "&INDEX({"Snowball","Avalanche","Custom"},R6)&"."
Every debt. Order is set by your strategy (Custom: number them 1, 2, 3...). Paid So Far comes from the Payment Log.
Your plan month by month. Debts Left counts debts that still have a balance.
Real payments you make. Pick the debt from the list.
The engine: 120 months. Each month: interest, minimums, then the rest goes to debts in payoff order. No need to edit.
